artworks.title: The Cup of Tea (La tasse de thé)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint with monoprint inking on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a person's upper body in profile view, seated and facing slightly to the right. The person's facial features are obscured by shadows, but their nose and mouth are visible. They are wearing dark clothing and a hat, and holding a small object in one hand. The background has a blurred, abstract pattern with vertical and diagonal lines.

artworks.title: The River God Nile
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 33 x 55.1 cm (13 x 21 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a reclining bearded figure surrounded by small cherubic figures and decorative elements. A large, muscular male figure with a laurel wreath lies horizontally across the lower portion of the image, exuding a classical, mythological presence reminiscent of river gods from ancient cultures. His body is positioned on what appears to be flowing water, surrounded by numerous small, infant-like figures engaged in playful activities and bearing symbols. To the right of the prominent figure, one cherubic child is holding a cornucopia, brimming with fruits and flowers. The area around the central figure incorporates intricate relief bordering the edges of the drawing, embellished with animals and ornate, vine-like scrollwork. The top section contains an inset of Latin text. The meticulous stippling and hatching techniques contribute to the texture and depth, rendering the drawing a marvel of classical revival style consistent with engravings from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Landscape with Two Deer
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon in the distance, small trees, and a possible structure. A large, gnarled tree with intricate foliage is in the foreground. Small figures on horseback are to the left, leading a group along a path that disappears into the landscape. The style uses cross-hatching and detailed strokes for texture. The color palette is monochrome with earthy tones, creating contrast and highlights.

artworks.title: Fantasy of an Antique Temple
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate architectural interior with a staircase leading to an arched doorway. It features columns with Corinthian capitals, niches, sculptures, and railings. A fountain is in the foreground with relief patterns and a spout. A grand arch frames the top of the scene adding depth to the architecture. The linework and hatching convey texture and shadow, emphasizing the design's grandiosity.

artworks.title: Fantasy of an Antique Trophy to Augustus
artworks.description: The image features a large ornate pedestal or monument decorated with shields, intricate patterns, a globe, urns, garlands, and other classical elements. The dominant colors are black and white due to the engraving style. The main structure occupies the center, stretching from bottom to top with detailed decorations. An urn is in the foreground on the right side. A figure leans on a staff in the lower left, facing the monument, adding scale and perspective.

artworks.title: Pink Roses
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: This detailed painting shows two pink roses and a pink bud on a long, thin green stem with green leaves and small green thorns. The tall stem rises near the right edge of the painting, with some thin branches reaching out to either side. The largest rose is positioned near the top left corner of the painting, with the small bud right below it. The other large flower is right around the center of the painting. The background is a flat beige color.

artworks.title: Asian Tea Pots
artworks.medium: watercolor on paper mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: There are two teapots in the image. The larger teapot has a decorative pattern of red leaves and blue curve on an olive-green background, with a white handle. The smaller teapot has a dark brown glossy finish. The color palette consists of earthy tones like browns, olive green, red, and blue. The larger teapot is positioned slightly to the right, behind the smaller one, which is in the foreground on a reflective green surface. The background has a light beige appearance.

artworks.title: Plum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: In the image, there is a red plum with a small stem casting a shadow. The plum is set against a textured beige background with the handwritten mark "JH 1903" in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Golden Robin (Northern Oriole)
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts
artworks.description: The image shows a bird with bright yellow and gray feathers lying on green grass and leaves. The color palette consists of vivid yellows, soft grays, and varying shades of green. The bird is positioned horizontally with its head on the left, blending into the lush foliage.

artworks.title: Still Life of Fruit: Apples, Pears, and Grapes on Ground
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William and Abigail Gerdts

artworks.title: La Lutschinen sortant du Glacier inférieur du Grindelwald
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in Memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: The image depicts a glacier surrounded by mountains. The horizon shows towering peaks blending with a cloudy sky. The painting features delicate brushstrokes capturing details of the ice and rocks. The color palette includes cool blues and greens for the ice, contrasting with earthy browns and tans for the mountains. Large mounds of glacier ice are seen on rocky terrain. In the distance, jagged peaks and a cluster of trees appear. A small group of figures in the midsection provides scale to the natural elements.

artworks.title: Vue du Schild-Wald-Bach prise en Hyver
artworks.medium: color etching and wash-manner engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul S. Morgan in Honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: The image shows a mountainous landscape with a high horizon featuring distant, snow-capped mountains. A waterfall flows down a sheer cliff into a forested area below. Rolling hills and mountains with snow are visible in the background. Two figures are depicted near the rocky landscape, offering scale. The sky is a mix of blues and grays with clouds. The color palette is naturalistic, contrasting warm and cool tones. Brushstrokes add texture and detail to rocks and water.

artworks.title: Boulogne
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint printed in gray-green on cream laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Given in memory of Mrs. Daryl Reich Rubenstein
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a dock or shoreline, looking out over a harbor filled with several sailboats anchored in tranquil water. Closest to us are the dark silhouettes of these boats, their masts and rigging sharply defined against the light reflected on the water. Beyond the boats, the horizon is low in the composition, crowded with the lights of a distant city or port, giving a sense of depth. The horizon forms a line where the water meets the cityscape. Smoke trails from stacked chimneys blend into the atmosphere. The sky and water are treated with crosshatched strokes, creating a textured effect that enhances the reflection of lights on the water. The overall color palette is monochromatic, dominated by shades of black, grey, and muted white.

artworks.title: Thomas Hoobs (Thomas Hobbes)
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man from the chest up. He is facing the viewer with medium-length, wavy hair that falls to his shoulders, a mustache with a small goatee, deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, and a serious or contemplative expression. He is wearing a dark, formal garment and a broad, white collar typical of an earlier period. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with lined patterns and Latin script, reading "PHILOSOPHIA EN QVAM." Below the oval, the engraving identifies the man as "THOMAS HOBBS Malmesburiensis," aged 76. The background has fine lines creating texture in the engraving.

artworks.title: Nathanael Dilgerus
artworks.description: The image portrays an older man with long, white hair, a white beard, and a white mustache. His deep-set eyes gaze directly at the viewer. He wears a garment with a wide collar and a vest with buttons. The portrait is framed in an oval with lined patterns around it. The background is dark and textured, and there is text at the bottom that includes the name "Nathanael Dilgerus" and a reference to age or date.

artworks.title: Pompone de Bellievre
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait from the chest up. He is slightly turned to his left but faces the viewer. The man has a mustache, small pointed beard, shoulder-length curly hair, and wears a cap. His clothing includes a robe with a fur collar. The background features an elaborate oval border with ornate decorations and a coat of arms at the base. A Latin inscription reads "POMPONIVS DE BELLIEVRE."

artworks.title: Willem van der Borcht
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 19.7 x 15.6 cm (7 3/4 x 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The portrait shows a man seated, facing slightly to his right. He has a full face with a prominent nose, a mustache, and a small goatee. His hair is of medium length, extending to the collar of his outfit. He wears a cap that fits closely to his head, a buttoned doublet or jacket, a wide white collar, and a dark cloak draped over one shoulder. The man holds a sheet or folded paper in his right hand against his waist. In the background, a framed artwork is partially visible on the wall in the upper left corner, and the rest of the background consists of a textured surface.

artworks.title: Charles II
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man's upper body. The man is facing forward with slightly turned shoulders. He has long curly hair, a prominent nose, slightly arched eyebrows, and a small mustache. He is wearing a lace collar over a dark garment and armor with intricate detailing. He wears a chain with a circular medallion around his neck. The background consists of an oval frame with parallel lines, enclosed by decorative swirling lines and a banner with the words "DIEU ET MON DROIT." Below the oval frame, there is a block of text with some flourishes indicating an inscription.

artworks.title: Sorrento
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone in memory of Albert Millstine
artworks.description: The image depicts a rocky landscape with sheer cliffs and a stairway path cut into the stone. A large building with arches is perched at the top of the cliffs, surrounded by trees. The artwork features precise pencil strokes detailing the rocks and trees, while the sky is softly shaded with clouds. The color scheme is monochromatic, with shades of beige and gray. The cliffs show rugged texture with visible lines and shading, and architectural elements and trees blend into the terrain leading to the sky.

artworks.title: The Rape of Deianira
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash on laid paper, mounted on album sheet
artworks.description: The image depicts a centaur capturing a woman while galloping, a man aiming a bow and arrow at the centaur, two figures seated and lying down, and an overturned vase. The background shows mountains, trees, and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: The Card Game (Der kleine l'Hombre Tisch)
artworks.medium: etching and sulfur tint with engraving in brown on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures seated around a table with a candle. The central figure faces the viewer. There is a candle illuminating the scene. The drawing is in sepia tone and features detailed textures on the figures and their surroundings.

artworks.title: Petit Port--La Corniche, Marseilles
artworks.description: The image displays a densely populated hilly townscape by the water from a slightly elevated angle. The composition features buildings, boats on water, and a rugged landscape with sketchy lines indicating foliage or rocky terrain. The style is characterized by rough, sketch-like lines typical of etching, creating a dynamic feel. The color palette is monochromatic using shades of sepia or graphite, giving a classic, timeless quality.

artworks.title: PARIS MARCHÉ AUX PUCES (Paris Flea Market)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded market. The image shows various stalls with different goods for sale, including clothing, wheels, and framed pictures. The scene is set in a busy urban street, with buildings in the background. A sign in French reads "Vente au Public," indicating a public sale. The drawing is done in a sketch-like style, with detailed linework portraying the vibrant and bustling atmosphere of a marketplace.

artworks.title: Mammy
artworks.medium: drypoint with sandpaper and roulette in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The seated person is viewed almost in profile from the waist up, with an upright posture in a chair and hands resting in their lap. Their facial features are silhouetted against a dark backdrop, with emphasis on the outline. The person wears a headscarf covering their hair and a flowing garment. The background has heavy, vertical lines resembling curtains. Light and shadow are used impressionistically, creating bright and dark contrasts throughout the image.
